name: @bitqate/cli
description: Command-line interface for the BitQate public API

scripts.build:binaries: bun build --compile src/index.ts --target=bun-linux-x64 --outfile=dist/bin/bitqate-linux-x64 && bun build --compile src/index.ts --target=bun-linux-arm64 --outfile=dist/bin/bitqate-linux-arm64 && bun build --compile src/index.ts --target=bun-darwin-x64 --outfile=dist/bin/bitqate-darwin-x64 && bun build --compile src/index.ts --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --outfile=dist/bin/bitqate-darwin-arm64 && bun build --compile src/index.ts --target=bun-windows-x64 --outfile=dist/bin/bitqate-windows-x64.exe
